summary_1line: Narada explains Karna’s past: his envy of the Pandavas, deception to learn divine weapons, and a Brahmin’s curse foretelling his death when his chariot wheel sinks.

image_candidates.scene_text: A furious Brahmin curses Karna beside the slain sacred cow on the lonely seashore while the warrior stands with bowed head and folded hands.
Karna approaches the ascetic Parashurama on the Mahendra mountains, claiming to be a Brahmin while bowing at the sage’s feet.
Karna wanders armed along the ocean coast near the hermitage just after accidentally killing the Brahmin’s ritual cow.
